units.source_text: 且说匂亲王回京之后，准备立刻像上次那样偷偷地微行，再赴宇治。

en.t: Now, after Prince Niou returned to the capital, he meant to slip away at once, just as he had before, and go again to Uji.

units.source_text: 夕雾左大臣的儿子卫门督却到宫中去揭发他的秘密：“匂皇子与宇治八亲王家女儿私通，

en.t: But Emon no Kami, a son of Yugiri the Minister of the Left, went to court and exposed his secret: "Prince Niou is having an affair with a daughter of the Eighth Prince of Uji,

units.source_text: 时常悄悄登程，远赴山乡。

en.t: and he often sets out in secret, traveling far away to that mountain village.

units.source_text: 世人都在私下讥议他的轻率行为呢。”

en.t: Everyone is privately criticizing him for such reckless conduct."

units.source_text: 明石皇后也听到了，甚是担心。

en.t: Empress Akashi heard of it as well and was deeply worried.

units.source_text: 皇上闻之，大为不悦，他说：“让他任性不羁地住在私邸里，毕竟是不好的。”

en.t: When the Emperor heard this, he was greatly displeased and said, "After all, it is not good to let him live so freely and willfully in a private residence."

units.source_text: 于是严加管束，从此要他经常住在宫中。

en.t: So he placed Prince Niou under strict supervision, and from then on required him to live regularly in the palace.
